visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a wooden bowl filled with cooked clams, garnished with thin white onion slices and a colorful red and green chili sauce. The lighting is bright and studio-like, emphasizing the glossy texture of the clam meat and the fresh vegetables. (2) Transition to a kitchen setting where a black pot sits on a portable stove with boiling water. A person's hand enters the frame to drop lemongrass stalks and lemon leaves into the water. White text overlays list the ingredients and quantities on the right side. (3) The hand adds raw clams into the bubbling water; the scene is shot at eye-level, focusing on the pot's interior as the water continues to boil vigorously. (4) Once opened, the clams are removed from the pot using pink-tipped tongs. The background shows a light-colored wooden countertop. (5) In a clear glass bowl, the hand uses a metal spoon to sequentially add minced garlic, chopped shallots, cilantro, red chilies, and red chili sauce. Measurements for each are displayed in an overlay. (6) Rice wine and sugar are poured into the sauce bowl and mixed thoroughly. The camera maintains a medium close-up shot on the glass bowl. (7) A clear liquid, presumably the clam broth, is poured into the sauce mixture. Then, the entire sauce is poured over the cooked clams in another bowl. (8) The bowl of sauce-covered clams is wrapped in clear plastic wrap by the cook's hands. Text indicates a 2-hour refrigeration period. (9) Final sequence features macro close-ups of a clam being picked up with fingers, showcasing the vibrant sauce and tender meat. The video ends with a beauty shot of the finished dish.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 泰式蛤蜊. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Subtitle]: 水 500c.c. 香茅 1根 檸檬葉 2片 大蛤蜊 20顆. (3) [Subtitle]: 蛤蜊吐完沙後 可以放入滾水中. (4) [Subtitle]: 蒜仁 30g 紅蔥 30g 香菜 30g 辣椒 30g 是拉差醬 50g 米酒 50c.c. 糖 20g. (5) [Subtitle]: 把煮完蛤蜊的水 加入調味料中. (6) [Subtitle]: 封保鮮膜 放入冰箱2小時.
